role: Push half of CloudKit session sync: batch selection with exponential backoff, record preparation (HealthKit strip, compress, encrypt, temp CKAsset), conflict/zone/prep-failure handling, zone management, live-backup forwarders and the timeout/no-progress watchdog helpers used by the full sync.
types: CloudSyncError: enum — LocalizedError with single case encryptionUnavailable (cloud key missing; fail closed)
CloudUploadExclusion: enum — Error thrown for sessions never uploaded: healthKitSourced (read whole out of Apple Health) and sampleData (sample nights)
CloudKitSyncManager: extension — push pipeline, zone management, asset building, error helpers, watchdog
CloudKitSyncManager.PreparedUpload: struct — Sendable wrapper around the CKRecord ready to save
state: mem:CloudKitSyncManager.pushCycleCounter (private static var, MainActor, in-memory only, reset each launch)
file:<tmp>/ck_<sessionId>_<8hex>.gz (CKAsset temp file, completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication, removed by cleanupTempAsset)
ck:HRVSession record fields written: sessionId, startDate, isDeleted=0, modifiedAt (via CloudKitSessionFreshness.stampRecord), sessionData (CKAsset)
ck:HRVSession isDeleted = keptOnDeviceMarker (2): a session excluded from upload (CloudUploadExclusion: HealthKit-sourced or sample data) and kept on this device, payload removed (markKeptOnDevice)
toplevel: Declares the two error enums and the static push tuning constants; pushCycleCounter starts at 0 per process and advances on every push cycle that reaches the batch. PreparedUpload is declared Sendable and holds a CKRecord. Comments note the failure counts behind the backoff are in memory only. keptOnDeviceMarker (nonisolated static let 2) is the isDeleted value of a record kept on one device.

units.does: Returns the localized Settings message for CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable: the encryption key is unavailable and data is never uploaded unencrypted.
units.entry: LocalizedError.errorDescription witness, read by Foundation when error.localizedDescription is taken (settings sync and live-backup error paths)

branches.effect: returns the localized 'encryption key is unavailable' string

units.does: Runs one push cycle: clears lastPushErrorMessage; if uploads are allowed and the schema is not flagged, takes up to 25 pending ids (pendingPushBatch), advances pushCycleCounter (also when the whole batch is deferred, so backoff windows move on), prepares each off-main and saves it, noting sync progress after every id whatever its outcome, stopping early on schema failure, task cancellation, an iCloud account no longer confirmed, or a bail from pushOne (zone gone, schema, or a save that returned after the watchdog fired); then writes sync_state.json (with record_versions.json) and pending_uploads.json with the async saves.

branches.cond: cloudUploadsAllowed false (sync off / onboarding unfinished) or schemaUnavailable
branches.effect: return without pushing; pending stays queued

branches.cond: batch is empty (nothing pending, or every pending id deferred)
branches.effect: return after advancing the counter; nothing saved

branches.cond: for each id in the batch
branches.effect: prepare and push it; progress noted at the end of each turn (defer)

branches.cond: schemaUnavailable became true, the task was cancelled (watchdog), or the account is no longer confirmed
branches.effect: break out of the loop; still saves state

branches.cond: prepareUpload returned nil (gone, local-only, prep failure)

branches.effect: break out of loop; otherwise continue

units.does: Prepares one session off-main via prepareUploadOffMain; returns the PreparedUpload, or nil after dropping a vanished session from the queue (markDeleted), keeping an excluded one (HealthKit-sourced or sample data) on-device, or classifying a prep failure.

branches.cond: archive.retrieve returned nil (session no longer in the archive)
branches.effect: log, state.markDeleted(id), return nil; else return prepared

branches.cond: catch CloudUploadExclusion (session read whole from Apple Health, or sample data)

units.does: Saves one prepared record and removes its temp asset on exit. A save that lands marks the session uploaded, remembers the change tag and clears any Trash-restore mark, unless the task was cancelled while it ran (stall watchdog) or the account is no longer confirmed (sync stopped meanwhile, or the account changed): then nothing is marked and the cycle stops. A serverRecordChanged goes to resolveConflict; zoneNotFound or userDeletedZone to handleZoneGone (ends the cycle); a permanent schema error flags the schema and ends the cycle; any other error marks the session failed and notes the save failure. Returns true to stop the cycle.

branches.cond: task cancelled while the save ran, or account no longer confirmed

units.does: Builds this cycle's batch: all archive entry ids plus pending ids, minus uploaded, quarantined and local-only ids, minus those still in backoff, truncated to 25 (Set iteration order, not oldest-first).

branches.effect: log that only the first 25 are processed

units.does: Returns defersForBackoff(failCount:bucket:cycle:) for the session, with its stored upload failure count (0 when none is recorded), its stableRetryBucket and the current pushCycleCounter.

Returns the number of push cycles between attempts for a session that has failed failCount times: 2^failCount with the exponent clamped to 0...maxBackoffExponent (6) before shifting, and the result capped at maxBackoffCycles (32).

Pure retry decision: false when failCount is 0 or less; otherwise period = backoffPeriod(failCount:) and the session defers unless (cycle + bucket % period) % period == 0, so it is tried once per period, on a cycle offset by its bucket.

branches.effect: return false (never deferred); otherwise apply the period test

units.does: Handles a serverRecordChanged for the batch push and, through resolveDirectConflict, the direct upload: without a server record marks the session failed; otherwise notes the server copy's edit stamp as seen (so this device's next edit stamps after it); if the server copy is a tombstone and this device did not restore it from Trash, applies the deletion locally; if it is marked kept on another device (keptOnDeviceMarker), counts the session as uploaded and leaves the record; otherwise copies local fields onto the server record (unless the server copy wins — newer, or same second and another version — in which case overwrite marks it uploaded), adds the restore marker if replacing a tombstone, and re-saves through saveResolved. Always returns false; persisting state is the caller's.

branches.cond: ?? — server isDeleted is not an Int64
server record isDeleted == 1 and session not restored from Trash on this device

branches.effect: markUploaded, return false; record left as it is

branches.cond: CloudKitSessionFreshness.overwrite returns false (server copy edited more recently, or in the same second and of a version this device does not hold)
branches.effect: return false; overwrite already marked it uploaded so the pull imports the newer copy

units.does: Saves the server record carrying this device's fields; on success, unless the task was cancelled while it ran (stall watchdog) or the account is no longer confirmed, marks the session uploaded, remembers the change tag and clears the Trash-restore mark; a failed save goes to noteConflictUnresolved.

branches.cond: task cancelled while the save ran, or account no longer confirmed

units.does: Marks a conflicted session failed (stays pending with backoff), feeds the error to CloudKitSessionFreshness.noteSaveFailure when given, and logs the reason.

branches.effect: noteSaveFailure(error) (may disable the modifiedAt field for this launch); else skip

units.does: Classifies a prep failure: non-archive or transient archive errors mark the session failed (retry with backoff), and a CloudSyncError (encryption key unavailable) is also kept as lastPushErrorMessage so the full sync ends as an error; a permanent archive error goes to hashRepair: repaired → failure count cleared, notNow (unreadable now, key unreachable, index not saved) → markFailed, undecodable (or newerSchemaVersion) → quarantined and quarantined_uploads.json saved.

branches.cond: error is not a SessionArchive.ArchiveError, or isPermanentUploadFailure is false
branches.effect: markFailed (+ lastPushErrorMessage when it is a CloudSyncError) + log, return
clearFailureCount so it retries next cycle

units.does: For a .hashMismatch, the result of SessionArchive.repairSessionHashIfDecodable; any other permanent archive error (.newerSchemaVersion) is .undecodable.

Keeps a session excluded from upload (CloudUploadExclusion: HealthKit-sourced or sample data) on this device: if it was uploaded or pending, removes the payload of its CKRecord and marks it kept on device (markKeptOnDevice; no tombstone, no outright delete); on success or when no copy exists, marks it local-only and saves local_only_sessions.json; on other failures marks it failed and returns.

branches.cond: session is in uploaded or pending set (may be in iCloud)
branches.effect: mark the record kept on device; else go straight to markLocalOnly
log 'no iCloud copy', fall through to markLocalOnly

units.does: Fetches the record with only isDeleted, sets isDeleted to keptOnDeviceMarker and clears sessionData, and saves it, so the record stays listed without a payload. Throws unknownItem when there is no record, and any fetch or save error.

The session zone is gone (deleted iCloud data or another account): logs and asks CloudAccountGuard.zoneWasDeleted, which stops sync when the account is confirmed or different; nothing is recreated. When the account cannot be checked, marks the session failed and keeps the reason as lastPushErrorMessage. Always returns true (ends the cycle).

branches.cond: account could not be checked (message returned)
branches.effect: markFailed and keep the message; else sync was stopped

units.does: Returns a stable per-UUID integer from the first three bytes of the UUID (b0 | b1<<8 | b2<<16), used as backoff jitter that does not reshuffle across launches (the failure counts themselves are in memory only).

Runs archive.retrieve + buildSessionRecord in a detached utility task; returns nil when the archive has no such session, throws on retrieval/encode/encrypt/upload-exclusion errors (HealthKit-sourced or sample data).

branches.effect: return nil; else build and wrap the record

units.does: Builds the HRVSession CKRecord (recordName = session UUID in zone HRVSessions) with sessionId, startDate, isDeleted=0, modifiedAt stamp and the encrypted sessionData asset; throws CloudUploadExclusion.healthKitSourced for sessions read whole from Apple Health and CloudUploadExclusion.sampleData for sample nights (DemoSessionSeeder.isSampleData), which the push then keeps on the device.
Returns a CKAsset backed by a protected temp file containing the compressed, encrypted, HealthKit-stripped session payload.

Strips the session via CloudSessionPayload.uploadable, JSON-encodes it (ISO-8601 dates, sorted keys), compresses it and seals it with CloudPayloadCodec.sealForUpload; throws CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable when no cloud key can be read or made, and encode/compress errors as they are.
Writes the payload to tmp/ck_<uuid>_<8 random>.gz with completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication and returns the URL.

Creates the HRVSessions zone once: skips when zoneCreated (UserDefaults) is true; throws Halt.stopped when the iCloud account is not confirmed (no zone is created in another account); otherwise saves the zone and sets zoneCreated; on a serverRejectedRequest fetches the zone and sets zoneCreated only when it exists (a failed fetch throws); other errors propagate.

branches.effect: fetch the zone: exists → zoneCreated = true; fetch throws → error propagates (not marked created). Other save errors rethrown

units.does: Removes the temp file behind the record's sessionData CKAsset, if present.

branches.cond: record has no sessionData CKAsset or the asset has no fileURL

units.does: Forwards a live RR backup upload to CloudKitLiveBackupManager.upload.
Forwards deletion of a live backup to CloudKitLiveBackupManager.delete.
Forwards to CloudKitLiveBackupManager.fetchAll and returns the live-backup summaries.
Deletes a file, ignoring 'no such file' and logging other errors.

branches.effect: debug-log it; file may remain in tmp

units.does: Maps an error to a user-facing sync message: non-CKErrors use localizedDescription; network errors, quotaExceeded, notAuthenticated and requestRateLimited (with retry-after) map to CloudSyncMessages; others use the CKError's localizedDescription.

branches.effect: CloudSyncMessages.rateLimited with CKErrorRetryAfterKey as Double (nil → plain 'Rate limited')

units.does: Races an async throwing operation against a timeout through Deadline.race (timeout SyncTimeoutError.timedOut): returns .success(value), .failure(the operation's error), .failure(SyncTimeoutError.timedOut) when the deadline passes first, or .failure(CancellationError) at once when the caller is cancelled. Used by the remote delete (CloudDeletionCoordinator.performDeleteAllRemoteData).

branches.effect: .failure(that error): the operation's error, SyncTimeoutError.timedOut, or CancellationError; else .success

units.does: Runs the operation in an unstructured Task and a poller Task; resumes with the operation's Result, or with .failure(SyncTimeoutError.stalled) once lastSyncProgressAt has been stale for stuckAfter seconds, then cancels (but does not await) the operation task.

branches.effect: fallback .failure(stalled); unreachable in practice because both resume calls pass a non-nil Result

units.does: Awaits the throwing operation and folds the result or thrown error into a Result.
Polls every 5 s until cancelled or the gate is resolved; returns as soon as lastSyncProgressAt is older than stuckAfter.

branches.cond: loop while not cancelled and gate unresolved
branches.effect: sleep 5 s each iteration; when the operation finished, returns within ≤5 s (caller's resume then no-ops)
return (caller fails the sync as stalled); else keep polling
